{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS090 |prevtitle=The Legend |nextcode=PS092 |nexttitle=Who Gives a Hoothoot? |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Murkrow Row |title_ja=VS ヤミカラス |title_ro=VS {{tt|Yamikarasu|Murkrow}} |image=PS091.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 91 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|8}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 91 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|8}} |location=[[New Bark Town]] }} '''Murkrow Row''' (Japanese: '''VS ヤミカラス''' ''VS {{tt|Yamikarasu|Murkrow}}''), titled '''Murkrow Flies''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 91st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the first chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Mom (Johto)|Gold's mother]] is shown cooking while she speaks to an {{p|Aipom}} on her shoulder, telling it to go and wake up {{adv|Gold}}. Aipom rushes down the corridor into Gold's bedroom. All of {{cat|Gold's Pokémon}} are waiting patiently for him to wake up and there is a {{wp|billiard}} cue at the rear end of his bed. One of Gold's jackets is neatly hanging on his bedside. More Pokémon are shown, possibly belonging to Gold himself. Aipom tries to nudge him awake, and the other Pokémon try as well. Gold finally wakes up dreary, however {{p|Lickitung}} soon sorts that. He heads downstairs and greets his mother who makes a funny comment about his hairstyle. Gold then picks up his skateboard and tells the Pokémon to get ready to play. Meanwhile, at [[Professor Elm]]'s research center in [[New Bark Town]], Professor Elm mentions the battle in [[Kanto]], possibly the one between {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}}. He then focuses on the three {{i|Poké Ball}}s on his desk that hold the [[Johto first partner Pokémon]]. A {{p|Hoothoot}} flies over leaving a view of what seems to be Gold's playroom. Now he is fully dressed and playing billiards. He is listening carefully to [[DJ Mary]]'s Pokémon Song Hour. As the song is playing he gets every ball in a pocket. The {{wp|radio}} crackles then dies down, and Gold is now cross. He then notices a shady figure in the backyard creeping around in the shadows. He jumps out of the window and confronts the figure calling him a thief and being very annoyed that his favorite song had been interfered with. The figure tells Gold that he is mistaken, and that his name is [[Joey]]{{tt|*|Grant in the Chuang Yi version}}. However, Gold tells his Aipom to attack the boy's {{p|Rattata}}. Joey then points up towards the tree where a {{p|Murkrow}} is residing peacefully along with a backpack and an antenna. Joey says it is his [[bag|backpack]] which he was supposed to be taking to the {{pkmn|Professor}}. Gold shoots up the Poké Ball of [[Aibo]], his Aipom, at the tree telling it to lower down the items first. Gold gets pulled up and uses his billiard cue to send a Poké Ball right into Murkrow. Gold nearly falls, but his Pokémon are there to save him. Gold welcomes Joey, but as he's about to leave he gets cross with Joey telling him to give him a recorded version of the show he missed. Joey spends the night, and the next day, they head off for Professor Elm's laboratory so that Joey can deliver important documents that were inside his backpack. ==Major events== * One year has passed since the end of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. * {{adv|Gold}} meets [[Joey]]. * Gold {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} a {{p|Murkrow}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * {{adv|Gold}} * [[Mom (Johto)|Gold's mother]] * [[Professor Elm]] * [[Joey]]/{{tt|Grant|Chuang Yi}} ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Aipom}} ({{OP|Gold|Aipom}}) * {{p|Murkrow}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Lickitung}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Chikorita}} * {{p|Totodile}} * {{p|Cyndaquil}} * {{p|Hoppip}} * {{p|Bellossom}} * {{p|Blissey}} * {{p|Smeargle}} * {{p|Pineco}} * {{p|Scizor}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Adv|Gold}} * [[Professor Elm]] * [[Joey]] * [[Mom (Johto)|Gold's mother]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Aipom}} ([[Aibo]]; {{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Poliwag}} ([[Polibo]]; {{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Drowzee}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Exeggcute}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Weedle}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Chansey}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Sandshrew}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Krabby}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Oddish}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Kakuna}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Lickitung}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Murkrow}} ({{Adv|Gold}}'s; new) * {{p|Chikorita}} ([[Megaree|Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Cyndaquil}} ([[Exbo|Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Totodile}} ([[Silver's Totodile|Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Hoppip}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Bellossom}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Sunkern}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Wooper}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Blissey}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Smeargle}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Pineco}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Scizor}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Rattata}} ([[Joey]]'s) * {{p|Hoothoot}} ==Trivia== *A [[Game Boy]] is seen on Gold's bed. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 黑暗鴉|VS Murkrow}} (Taiwan)
